facts.text: Teth was a jungle planet located in Wild Space of the galaxy.

evidence.quote: Teth was a jungle planet located in Wild Space of the galaxy.

facts.text: Some distance from the B'omarr monasteries and the Tomb of Ziro the Hutt's father, an area of mysterious rock formations could be found on the surface of Teth.
entities: Tomb of Ziro the Hutt's father

evidence.quote: Some distance from the B'omarr monasteries and the Tomb of Ziro the Hutt's father, an area of mysterious rock formations could be found on the surface of Teth.

facts.text: Situated along the Triellus Trade Route, Teth orbited its system's singular star and was orbited by two moons.

evidence.quote: Situated along the Triellus Trade Route, Teth orbited its system's singular star and was orbited by two moons.

facts.text: On the surface was a mix of rocky ground and tangled jungle, all cast in shades of deep purple to light mauve by its atmosphere, which was comfortably breathable for Hutts, humans and other species.

evidence.quote: On the surface was a mix of rocky ground and tangled jungle, all cast in shades of deep purple to light mauve by its atmosphere, which was comfortably breathable for Hutts, humans and other species.

facts.text: The trees that populated the jungles had serpentine trunks which twisted and coiled upwards, and were bedecked with thick vines.

evidence.quote: The trees that populated the jungles had serpentine trunks which twisted and coiled upwards, and were bedecked with thick vines.

facts.text: Wherever there was a break in the canopy, the thick ground would cover thrives as tall rock columns thrusted upward from the lowland jungles.

evidence.quote: Wherever there was a break in the canopy, the thick ground would cover thrives as tall rock columns thrusted upward from the lowland jungles.

facts.text: Eventually, however, many of these monasteries were abandoned, allowing them to fall under Hutt control.

evidence.quote: Eventually, however, many of these monasteries were abandoned, allowing them to fall under Hutt control.

facts.text: Hutt activities eventually claimed control over Teth, a conquest akin to the Neimoidians' control over their luxurious purse worlds.

evidence.quote: Hutt activities eventually claimed control over Teth, a conquest akin to the Neimoidians' control over their luxurious purse worlds.

facts.text: Hutt control was disruptive, but it did bring an economic boom of sorts to Teth for a short period of time, albeit from illicit sources.

evidence.quote: Hutt control was disruptive, but it did bring an economic boom of sorts to Teth for a short period of time, albeit from illicit sources.

facts.text: At some stage, the Republic declared something of an open war against the Hutt operations on Teth due to the open displays of wealth being flaunted by the Hutts.

evidence.quote: At some stage, the Republic declared something of an open war against the Hutt operations on Teth due to the open displays of wealth being flaunted by the Hutts.

facts.text: A pirate group made an effort to operate from Teth but was countered by Jedi Master Plo Koon and lawman Janu Godalhi, whose successes against the pirates made the final Hutt decide it was time to leave Teth.

evidence.quote: A pirate group made an effort to operate from Teth but was countered by Jedi Master Plo Koon and lawman Janu Godalhi, whose successes against the pirates made the final Hutt decide it was time to leave Teth.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, Separatist leader Count Dooku's assassin, Asajj Ventress, brought Jabba the Hutt's infant son Rotta to an abandoned B'omarr monastery once used by their ally, Ziro Desilijic Tiure, after she kidnapped Rotta from Tatooine.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, Separatist leader Count Dooku's assassin, Asajj Ventress, brought Jabba the Hutt's infant son Rotta to an abandoned B'omarr monastery once used by their ally, Ziro Desilijic Tiure, after she kidnapped Rotta from Tatooine.

facts.text: The bounty hunters were killed and their severed heads sent back to Jabba, but the two ARF troopers were able to report back to Galactic Republic forces about the whereabouts of the kidnapped child and leave unnoticed.

evidence.quote: The bounty hunters were killed and their severed heads sent back to Jabba, but the two ARF troopers were able to report back to Galactic Republic forces about the whereabouts of the kidnapped child and leave unnoticed.

facts.text: Jedi General Anakin Skywalker, his Padawan Ahsoka Tano, and Torrent Company then led a mission to rescue the Huttlet from the battle droid battalion that guarded the monastery.

evidence.quote: Jedi General Anakin Skywalker, his Padawan Ahsoka Tano, and Torrent Company then led a mission to rescue the Huttlet from the battle droid battalion that guarded the monastery.

facts.text: Several rebel groups could come to operate from Teth during the Imperial Era, the time period of the Galactic Empire that arose after the end of the Clone Wars.

evidence.quote: Several rebel groups could come to operate from Teth during the Imperial Era, the time period of the Galactic Empire that arose after the end of the Clone Wars.

facts.text: The Clone Underground utilized the B'omarr Order monastery on Teth as a base of operations.

evidence.quote: The Clone Underground utilized the B'omarr Order monastery on Teth as a base of operations.

facts.text: Another faction of rebels, who operated outside the eventual Alliance to Restore the Republic, also made Teth into their base of operations, launching strikes against Imperial supply routes connected to the Corporate Sector from Teth.

evidence.quote: Another faction of rebels, who operated outside the eventual Alliance to Restore the Republic, also made Teth into their base of operations, launching strikes against Imperial supply routes connected to the Corporate Sector from Teth.

facts.text: The Hutts, meanwhile, decided the time was right to return to Teth after the fall of the Republic.

evidence.quote: The Hutts, meanwhile, decided the time was right to return to Teth after the fall of the Republic.

facts.text: Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, Grakkus the Hutt, who had been captured by the Alliance to Restore the Republic, was aboard the Millennium Falcon being escorted by Han Solo and Chewbacca to a prison on Akiva, where he would be interrogated to reveal the location of a personal hideout with res...
